run_upscale_pipeline: run the StableDiffusionUpscalePipeline to upscale a low resolution image using a text prompt
encode_prompt_embeddings: encode a text prompt into CLIP text embeddings using the encode_prompt method
prepare_latents: prepare random Gaussian latents scaled by the scheduler init noise sigma
check_inputs: validate prompt, image, noise level, and callback steps before running the upscale pipeline
preprocess_image: preprocess PIL images or tensors by resizing to multiples of 64 and normalizing
